Name: Heavy tf2 over the cat
Author: Judelplums
Description:
[youtube]DsnrB1TbPD4[/youtube][youtube]2-DmHjLuvpE[/youtube]
(video one is gameplay, video 2 is installation instrustions) This mod is a skin over the cat models that makes said cat into the heavy from tf2. it is just a still image of the heavy from tf2 sliding around. The mod is version 1.0.0, and should work on most Stardew Valley versions. Doesnt need any programs to install, just access the Stardew Valley files and add the files, as shown in the youtube video. This has been tagged by users as 'real world issues' and 'horror'

loadout for tf2 - Necrosmasher, sandvich
